newsitem.title: USA: N. American meningitis drug ends Phase I.
newsitem.headline: N. American meningitis drug ends Phase I.

text.p: North American Vaccine Tuesday said its just-completed Phase I adult clinical study for its meningitis vaccine showed that the drug was well tolerated with minimal reactogenicity and no serious side-effects.

The safety and immunogenicity clinical trial was sponsored by North American Vaccine and was conducted in conjunction with the Institute of Child Health at the University College London Medical School, London, England.

The results from the trial also revealed that antibodies elicited by immunization with the polysaccharide conjugate vaccine against Group C meningococcal infection displayed protective activity against meningococcal C.
Currently there is no polysaccharide conjugate vaccine licensed by the FDA for the prevention of group C meningococcal infections, the company said.
